steps: Elis saves you from the dolls, easing Alina's suspicions. Over the following days, you and Elis grow closer through palm-written chats. Reaching Filanis, you feel a faint familiarity…
These puppets are relentless. Alina hacked them to pieces before she ran off, but...
Now they're actually tearing off their own limbs and slapping together five new bodies.
Thank goodness for sturdy bars. Mindless bashing won't leave a dent.
At this rate... I'll be perfectly safe right here until I starve.
But unless someone rescues me, I'll end up starving forever.
Alright, panicking won't help. Time to retrace my steps.
I remember...==W== I tried to use my ability to "undo a move" and beat Angie. To find a way out where nobody had to die.
But that meant throwing my own life away. I'd be dead if Vita hadn't blocked the shot with the Throne.
The Throne shattered. I woke up locked in the White Room, with no Monolith staff in sight. It was just an endless void.
I walked and walked ... until my mind went numb. Then I heard a familiar voice and pushed open another door.
Which dumped me here.==W== It feels like waking up on the Lucky Oasis all over again, except...
Noya is a Night Watcher,==W== Iris is the Fallen Saintess,==W== and Amber ... is nowhere in sight.
... Is this a dream? No, you can't dream up things you don't know.
An illusion inside the White Room? Another world entirely? I have no idea.
Doesn't matter. I found an exit in the White Room, which means I haven't lost yet.
Getting my head chopped off wasn't ideal, but I still squeezed through the door of fate.
Dead end or not, there's a way out of here. For the others, and for Vita... I have to get back!
What is going on? Why is the carriage shaking?
Wait, why are they all crowding one side of the cart?!
They're trying to tip it! If it falls, they can reach me through the bars!
Alina! Get back here! The cage is giving way!
God of Magic, grant me your blazing holy fire...
F-Fire magic?! Hey, don't roast me alive!
See, my dear Master? You always end up needing me. That Night Watcher is completely useless.
She saw those bars and figured brute force wouldn't cut it. But she forgot these things have half a brain. An iron wall means nothing if the enemy can just climb over it.
Why are you here? Alina is close. If she sees you, she'll arrest you. You should go.
Oh? My Master actually worries about me. I'm flattered.
I'm a murderous Fallen Saintess, remember?
You've seen my face and heard my voice. Aren't you afraid I'll silence my only witness?
If you came to silence me, you wouldn't have saved me. Letting the puppets do it would be much easier.
Besides... You might be the Fallen Saintess, but I don't think you'll kill to cover your tracks.
Fascinating. You woke up half an hour ago, and we just met. Where is this trust coming from?
Don't tell me ... you fell for my looks, or do you just enjoy hearing me call you Master?
Because==W== I refuse to believe anyone with Iris's face is a murderer...==W==Heh. Good luck saying that out loud.
Ahem. It's not your looks. It's how you operate.
Not my looks, huh? I get it. You are charmed. You just have other reasons to trust me.
Now I'm curious. What exactly did my actions give away?
Well... This cheeky attitude is nothing like Iris. I'd better just spell it out for her.
You're a powerful mage. If you're a ruthless killer, there is no need for you to drag a groggy amnesiac into a fake identity.
Alina is a veteran. She poked holes in my answers in seconds. Against someone like that, a magical ambush would've been your best bet.
When we stepped outside, you did lay down a magic circle. But it was a haste spell, non-lethal.
Habits are hard to break. You avoid hurting people, and you clearly tried to keep me out of the crossfire. You're no ruthless killer.
Tsk. What a day. First a sharp Night Watcher, and now a Master bending over backward to prove my innocence.
Enough about me. We need to move.
Exactly. Let's see that Night Watcher catch us now. She can stay in this forest and play with those junk piles all night.
God of Magic, grant me your blazing holy fire... Burn away these wicked woods!
Right magic, wrong chant. She has some bizarre casting habits...
Wait, did the puppets' faces just change color?
The wind blades ... disappeared?! Do they have anti-wind wards on them?!
God of Magic, let the swiftest wings of the forest heed my command. Cleanse this clamorous world!
H-How is that possible? No one wastes two different wards on scrap!==W== Wait... Not just wards. They're feeding on my magic!
Ugh... My magic is useless. We're surrounded.
Get inside! The cage will hold them!
I can't. If I open the door now, they'll flood inside,==W== and we're both dead...
Upon the foundation of my soul, with my spirit as the mortar... I seal my Master's cage. Weather the storm, stand firm against the gale, endure the searing flame...
I finally met someone who understands me. I'm not letting you die today, Acolyte. This is all the magic I have left. Take it.
This ward should hold... At least until the Night Watcher returns...==W==
They suddenly got tougher. I don't recognize the magic warding them...
Alina, cut off the magic! They are absorbing it from your blade!
Ah, I see.==W== Then I will cut them down with pure steel!
Just as I thought. This is much easier.
Incredible... She cut through fifty,==W== no, at least a hundred puppets on pure swordplay alone?!
==SEX12== Acolyte, are you alright? Any injuries?
I was safe in the cart. Go find Elis! The puppets just buried her!
Don't worry. Your slave had the good sense to duck beneath the wreckage for cover while I was swinging.
You are one to talk! That last swing nearly took my head off!
Wait. What did you just call me?
I checked the puppets in the forest. Your magic did not animate them.==W== Furthermore, I saw what you did...
You used your last reserves of magic shielding the Acolyte just as you were about to be overrun. A Fallen Saintess would never do such a thing. A fiercely loyal slave would.
You may still be the Fallen Saintess hiding behind a clever disguise, but this truth lies beyond my mortal judgment now.
I am taking you both to Filanis. My Patron,==W== the great Archon Olympia, will judge your identity and decide your fate.

==A-2==After Alina abruptly ceased her interrogation, we resumed our journey.==P== ==A-1==On paper, Elis remains a sinner and I her suspect accomplice. Yet Alina treats us exactly like an Acolyte and ==SEX3== attendant, affording us all the respect the titles carried.==P== ==A-1==Even our three daily meals are leagues better than her own rations.
Bouncing along in the cart, Elis and I grow closer, developing a highly unorthodox method of conversation.
(Trace it with me again, ==PLAYER_NAME==! An Acolyte who cannot even write ==SEX3== own name is a fatal flaw.)
(Understood. One more time. Is this right?)
(I will handle all the writing from now on. It perfectly fits the personal slave disguise anyway.)
(Why did Alina abandon the interrogation the other day? Any thoughts?)
(A few. She is sharp. She likely noticed the same discrepancy you did. My behavior is nothing like the Fallen Saintess she knows about.)
(Plus, you look the part of a noble. Wrongfully arresting your personal slave would land her a severe reprimand from her Patron.)
(But you really are the runaway Saintess, right?)
(There's no point hiding it from you. I fled the ritual, but I've just been studying magic in a tower near Emor for three years.)
(I know nothing of those crimes. When we get out, I'll show you my daily journals in the tower. They'll prove my innocence!)
(I was fast asleep a few days ago in the tower.)
(Then that Night Watcher just burst in with a portrait and tried to arrest me.)
(I ran through the Monolith. Just as I was about to collapse, I spotted an ornate coffin.)
(I went to hide inside, but surprise, you were already in it.)
(You were dressed like royalty, so I claimed you were an Acolyte in a resurrection trance, and I was your slave standing guard.)
(Volunteering to be a slave... Is that really necessary?)
(You really don't remember anything. Slaves are property. If she wants to arrest me, she needs your permission first.)
(As long as I claim to be yours, she has to verify your ownership before dragging me away, Fallen Saintess or not.)
(So she loaded you and the coffin onto the cart for an investigation. She even warned me that if our identities didn't match, she'd charge me with desecrating a corpse.)
(Thanks to you, I bought some time. Otherwise, I'd be in shackles with no way to draw a single magic circle.)
(Speaking of which, who are you? And why were you in a coffin at the top of that Monolith? I never saw anyone go up there in three years.)
There is no possible way I can explain crossing into this world through the White Room... I'll just have to give her the abridged version.
(I'm no Acolyte, and I'm from far, far away. As for why I ended up in the Monolith with that coffin, I honestly have no idea.)
(Doesn't matter. You look the part anyway. No one will doubt the Acolyte disguise. Just let me do the talking in Filanis so we don't blow our cover.)
(I'll keep playing your slave.==W== But seriously, be a bit more ruthless with me. Show some authority! Nobody treats a slave as gently as you do.)
(The same applies to the Night Watcher. Drop the polite facade. It breaks character. But if she serves you well, offer a suitable reward.)
(Speaking of which... Is this palm-writing trick actually fooling Alina?)
(Undoubtedly. She is preoccupied with the horses. And even if she suspects conspiracy, I have other ways to divert her attention.)
Crap, we were so focused I didn't even notice the cart stop.==W== We're busted!
When you rub it like that, it feels ...==W== strange. Could you be ...==W== a little gentler with your fingers?
What kind of insane cover story is this?!
Ahem. Intimate eccentricities between master and slave are to be expected,==W== but you have lingered quite long enough. It is time to disembark.
Considering your presumed status, parading you into the city in a prisoner cart before the facts are clear would be a disgrace.
Ahem. How exceptionally thoughtful of you. My Master is a distinguished Acolyte. ==SEX1== absolutely cannot present ==SEX8== to the Archon in such filth.
Indeed. Considering your situation, I specifically chose a bathhouse closed to the public today. We are the only ones here.
How thoughtful. Though this place hardly looks fit to house a bathhouse. Is Filanis really this backwater?
This is not Filanis proper. It is merely a spontaneous settlement erected on the outskirts.
Behold. The city gleaming in the sunlight on the lake island, built around that tower.
A Monolith on a lake island ...==W== and this exact street layout.
That is the true Filanis.==W== The great City of Perfection.
